custody_model: Non-custodial smart-contract lending market on Flow EVM.
yield_source: Supplier yield is generated from borrower interest and protocol lending-market activity; realized returns depend on market utilization and protocol risk.
risk_notes: The 2026-08-31 incident affected the mFlowWFLOW reserve. Blockaid linked the exploit path to an Ankr bonded liquid-staking token and E-Mode configuration, but final root cause, bad debt and lender loss remained under investigation.
